Definition: Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jephthah or Jiphtah = "he opens"; n pr m; 1) a son of Gilead and a concubine and the judge who defeated the Ammonites; after the victory because of a vow taken before the battle he sacrificed his daughter as a burnt offering; n pr loc; 2) a city in Judah
